text: Profile Neohesperidin dihydrochalcone is an intense sweetener derived from naringin, a flavonoid present in citrus peel. It is about 1000 to 1500 times as sweet as sucrose and is used in foods, beverages, and pharmaceuticals. It has a synergistic sweetening effect when used with other sweeteners. Neotame Neotamo.
